title: Art. 2.17.4 — American Convention on Human Rights, Part I, Chapter II, Article 17, Paragraph 4
content: The States Parties shall take appropriate steps to ensure the equality of rights and the adequate balancing of responsibilities of the spouses as to marriage, during marriage, and in the event of its dissolution. In case of dissolution, provision shall be made for the necessary protection of any children solely on the basis of their own best interests.
